# Tencent TRTC Web SDK

`trtc-5.19.2.mjs` is the unmodified `trtc.esm.js` from the official `trtc-sdk-v5@5.19.2` npm package. Package metadata is preserved in `trtc-5.19.2-package.json`.

- Author: Tencent Cloud Client R&D Center
- Declared package license: ISC
- Source package: https://registry.npmjs.org/trtc-sdk-v5/-/trtc-sdk-v5-5.19.2.tgz
- Official repository: https://github.com/LiteAVSDK/TRTC_Web
- Documentation: https://web.sdk.qcloud.com/trtc/webrtc/v5/doc/zh-cn/index.html

The published package does not include a separate LICENSE file; original notices in the SDK have been retained. No plugins, video codecs, denoisers, or remote debug assets are bundled or enabled. The SDK is loaded only after an authenticated user explicitly starts an enabled realtime session.
